$comment: Dependencies the Phobos memory engine requires. The wizard reads this and runs `npm install` for each entry. Pinned to caret ranges for stability. onnxruntime-node is declared as a top-level dep (not relying on it being installed as optional sub-dep of @xenova/transformers) because some npm flags / package managers skip optional deps and that crashes the engine at runtime with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
